history_before_v4.rule: When contemporaneous V4 observations do not exist, historical reconstruction may be corrected using later accepted sources; never represent it as what the system knew at the time.

history_from_v4_go_forward.rule: Record provider availability, observation, ingestion, and system availability timestamps with source revision identity; corrections append a superseding revision and never overwrite prior observations.

acceptance_meaning: PASS means the lineage boundary is explicit and enforced; it does not certify reconstructed history as AS_RECORDED.
